cultivars.propagation: division of offshoots and rhizome cuttings
cultivars.description: Dionaea 'Werewolf' is an ICPS-registered cultivar of Dionaea muscipula. The cultivar authority is G.Hoogenstrijd. It was originated by G.Hoogenstrijd of Araflora, Amsterdam, NL & Stefan Lenssen, DE, 2011. The registration was submitted by G.Hoogenstrijd & S.Lenssen on 10 May 2013. It was published in Bailey & McPherson, Dionaea:330 (2013). The registered etymology is: after marginal lashes of traps resembling a werewolf's claws. Its registration standard is Bailey & McPherson, Dionaea:330, Fig. 360 (2013). Cultivar characteristics are defined by that registration; consult the ICPS register entry for the full description.
